input: Round 2 lane 2 (shed-designer): numbers that drift; then owner store feedback and a fastener audit
task: shed-designer round 2 lane 2: stop drifting numbers (generated size pages, tested README/marketing figures), store comparison like for like, overhang budget, fastener audit
errors: Committed unresolved conflict markers in the README on #11528 once; caught by the README test and fixed before merge.
#11524 broke two things after it merged: pages.yml had no setup-node for the generator (fixed in #11641), and renders.test.mjs read size pages from disk (fixed in #11654).
An instructions test hard-coded a 6" overhang and failed once the auto overhang moved; pinned it to autoOverhang:false.
Fastener post first said 660 siding nails (the build needs 600) and gave the wrong preset counts; corrected before merge.

doc_friction.issue: Suggests `node --test *.test.mjs`; the shed-designer suite takes 3-5 minutes and must run in the background.
Its guidance on merging generated size pages went stale once #11524 landed; the round-2 lane report replaces it.

deviations.why: Merged #11524, #11528, #11547, #11641, #11654, #11595 and #11620 on local verification while CI runners were starved, as allowed; evidence on each PR and in notes.
Closed #11590 (spares rule) unmerged: measured on current main it cost more and was less stable.
Left model null: this environment forbids model identifiers in pushed files.

notes: PRs: #11524, #11641, #11654, #11528, #11547, #11595, #11620 merged; #11571 closed as superseded (parts landed via a9ba244b, #11640, #11650, #11641); #11590 closed with measurements. Local verification: shed-designer full suite (node --test *.test.mjs) passed on each branch after merging main; marketing.test.mjs 263/263; gitops suite 603 passed; full site build with size pages deleted from disk passed check.mjs (5,575 pages, no dead links). Measured: lumber +-5% changed board count on 188/240 size-page builds, pieces 0. Default 8x12 now $3,143.08 with the fastener fix; auto overhang 8" (9" would add $40.47).
